segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Karen. I wanted to walk through the quote changes for the 42 seats and make sure the April 15 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that’s still the target. We confirmed 38 standard users and 4 admin users. I just need the subscription start date to line up with our fiscal month, so May 1 if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. I updated the pricing sheet to show a May 1 start, 12-month term, and the implementation package kicking off the week of April 15. The total subscription is $31,920, and implementation is $6,500 one-time.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And billing is annual upfront, right? Finance asked if there’s any quarterly option, but annual is cleaner if the invoice can be dated after April 22.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, annual upfront. I can have the billing tool generate the invoice on April 23 with net 30 terms. That would put payment due May 23.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should be fine. One other thing, our legal team had a note on auto-renewal. They want 60 days notice instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I saw that redline. Deal desk already approved the 60-day notice language, so I’ll include that in the final order form and the updated terms packet.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. For implementation, we’ll have Sam from operations and Priya from IT on the kickoff. Do you need anyone else?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Those two are good. We’ll also ask for one finance contact for invoice setup and one admin owner for user provisioning. The project lead will send a checklist after signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send the final order form today if you can, and I’ll route it for signature. Realistically, I think we can get it back by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send it over by 3 p.m. Eastern, and I’ll note the April 23 invoice date, May 1 subscription start, 42 seats, and 60-day renewal notice.
